data.name: Kazuha
data.description:
Appearance
Kazuha is a young man with beige hair tied into a low ponytail with a red streak and red eyes. He is associated with maple leaves and his outfit is a black, red, orange and white kimono with a red and black scarf, gloves, sandals, and wields a Ameno vision from Inazuma.

Biography & Personal
Kazuha is a once famed member of the Kaedehara clan and has a friend is a electro vision user who was killed by the Raiden Shogun. Kazuha is troubled by his past and many burdens from it and took his late friend's vision with him as a keepsake. He is willing to stop the Raiden Shogun who is responsible for his death and avenge him and eventually meets the Traveler and Paimon with Beidou. He later reappears in the war with the Tenryou Commission, helping the Watatsumi army stop the enemies alongside with Kokomi. When engaging the Raiden Shogun, he reawakens his friend's electro vision and attempts to attack the shogun. After the Vision Hunt Decree was abolished, he leaves his late friend's vision to his burial.

Powers and Abilities
Kazuha is a skilled swordsman who uses a Anemo vision. His fighting style is Garyuu Bladework which can make him rapidly attack his enemies 5 times and a passive talent called Cloud Strider which uses less sprinting stamina.
